IIM Ahmedabad Indian Fama-French-Momentum data library
Agarwalla, S. K., Jacob, J. and Varma, J. R. (2013), Four factor model in Indian
equities market, IIMA Working Paper 2013-09-05 (data updated periodically).

Page:    https://faculty.iima.ac.in/iffm/Indian-Fama-French-Momentum/
Files:   https://faculty.iima.ac.in/iffm/Indian-Fama-French-Momentum/DATA/<file name>
Release: 2025-12 (coverage 1993-10 to 2025-12); files dated 22 Jan 2026.
Re-checked 2026-09-21: 2025-12 is still the latest release on the page.
Access:  public, no login; the page asks only for the citation above.

Files are saved unmodified. Values are percent per month.
Used by jobs/crosscheck_iima.py, which reads only 2016-01..2022-12 (holdout lock).

2026-11-01: added the daily four-factor file of the same release
(2025-12_FourFactors_and_Market_Returns_Daily_SurvivorshipBiasAdjusted.csv, 831,223 bytes,
1993-10-01 to 2025-12-31, saved unmodified). Re-checked that day: 2025-12 is still the latest
release. Compounding the daily file by calendar month reproduces the monthly file exactly in all
385 months (MF, SMB, HML, WML, RF). Used by zen-portfolios research/comove.py (styles).
